headline: Elon Musk’s proposed SpaceX stock giveaway would go into ‘Trump Accounts’
summary: Elon Musk plans to give one SpaceX share to "every kid in America" next year. President Trump announced these shares would be distributed via "Trump Accounts". Musk thanked Brad Gerstner for enabling this initiative.

headline: The fossil fuel comeback is here
summary: A new report shows the US is building more fossil fuel infrastructure than in a decade. Renewable energy growth is simultaneously slowing down. Electricity demand is surging due to data centers, factories, and EVs.

headline: CoreWeave’s debt is becoming the whole AI industry’s problem
summary: CoreWeave's bonds recently slipped into distressed territory. This indicates investors are demanding significantly higher yields. The situation raises concerns about a potential private credit bubble in the AI sector.

headline: I tried a $99 plug that promises to track your car and send help when needed — without selling your data
summary: The Miles Plug is a $99 device for vehicle tracking and health monitoring. It offers emergency accident response and roadside assistance. The device promises to protect user data privacy.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Pop-Up: The DMZ Has Never Been This Much Fun
summary: A Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 pop-up event is receiving praise. The DMZ mode is highlighted for its enjoyable gameplay experience. Players are finding new levels of fun within the game.

headline: Save $150 Off the 2026 MacBook Air With New Apple M5 Chip Ahead of Black Friday
summary: A $150 discount is available for the 2026 MacBook Air. This deal features the new Apple M5 chip. The offer is a pre-Black Friday sale on a highly recommended laptop.

headline: Clayface Stars Praise Batman: The Animated Series and Ron Perlman's 'Amazing' Performance as the DC Villain
summary: Stars from 'Clayface' expressed their admiration for 'Batman: The Animated Series'. They specifically praised Ron Perlman's 'amazing' performance as the DC villain. The actors recalled growing up watching the show in the UK.

headline: The Legend of Zelda Encyclopedia Is on Sale at Amazon Today
summary: The 'Legend of Zelda Encyclopedia' is currently on sale. The discount is available on Amazon. This is a limited-time offer for fans of the franchise.

headline: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
summary: Curfews have been imposed in central Paris and other French cities. This action follows widespread rioting across France. The country's interior minister admitted police had 'lost control' in some areas.

headline: Watch: Clean up begins after French riots but police remain
summary: Clean-up operations have commenced in French cities following extensive riots. Police forces remain present in the affected areas. Marseille reported significant damage, with over 600 premises looted.

headline: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
summary: A Zelensky adviser claims Ukrainians are dying due to US intelligence sharing restrictions. He states there's insufficient time to warn citizens of incoming missile attacks. The White House denies any changes to intelligence sharing policies.

headline: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget
summary: The Chancellor has rejected proposals to increase Capital Gains Tax (CGT) in the upcoming Budget. Influential Labour figures had pushed for equalizing CGT and income tax. Critics warned that higher CGT could drive wealthy individuals out of Britain.
